::: hero
# Think deeply. Build precisely.s

Olinfo is a lecture series for high-school students preparing for competitive programming and computer science olympiads.

[Explore the lectures](lectures/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

## What you will learn

::::::::: grid
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: course-card
### Algorithmic thinking

Turn a difficult problem into a sequence of ideas, invariants, and efficient algorithms.
:::
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: course-card
### Mathematical tools

Use combinatorics, number theory, and proof techniques to understand why an algorithm works.
:::
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: course-card
### Contest practice

Develop the habits needed to read problems carefully, choose constraints wisely, and implement reliably.
:::
::::
:::::::::

## How the course is organised

Each section corresponds to an in-person lecture. A lecture page can contain preparation, notes, worked examples, exercises, and optional follow-up material. Start with the [lecture overview](lectures/index.qmd) or browse the sections in the sidebar.
